Run a simulator across a scenario grid

Source: R/api.R
simulate_scenarios.Rd

Scenario columns are matched to simulator arguments. Identifier and replication columns are added to each generated observation, which makes the result immediately suitable for grouped estimation and recovery checks.

Usage

simulate_scenarios(
  scenarios,
  simulator,
  ...,
  id = "scenario_id",
  replication = "replication",
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

scenarios

A base data.frame, commonly from scenario_grid().

simulator

Canonical simulator name from list_simulators().

...

Arguments held constant across scenarios.

id

Scenario identifier column.

replication

Replication column.

seed

Optional base seed. Each row receives a deterministic offset.

Value

A combined simulab_sim base data.frame; the scenario grid is a secondary component.

Examples

scenarios <- scenario_grid(mean_b = c(0, 0.5), replications = 2)
result <- simulate_scenarios(
  scenarios, simulator = "ttest",
  n_a = 20, n_b = 20, mean_a = 0, seed = 1
)
head(result)
#> <simulab_sim:scenarios> 6 rows x 5 columns
#>   scenario_id replication id group    outcome
#> 1           1           1  1     A -0.6264538
#> 2           1           1  2     A  0.1836433
#> 3           1           1  3     A -0.8356286
#> 4           1           1  4     A  1.5952808
#> 5           1           1  5     A  0.3295078
#> 6           1           1  6     A -0.8204684
